versions.label: Steam Linux (build 11668867)
versions.testedOn: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra (SM-F976B), Adreno 840, Android 17
versions.notes: Native x86-64 Feral Vulkan port, launched through Steam with FEX 2610 Performance, Ubuntu 24.04, Turnip 26.3 for Adreno 8xx and native Vulkan output. Needs this app's Linux shim (anti-debug ptrace answer, robust_list, gamepad files, and the ignored self-raised SIGFPE that otherwise deadlocks Feral's crash reporter and runs the phone out of memory). Gameplay in the opening cave levels, the gamepad (Bluetooth and on-screen), Steam toasts and the HUD were checked on build 11668867; about 45-57 FPS at 1024x768-1280x800, GPU-bound (35-50 at 1920x1200). If the 'Tomb Raider servers are currently unavailable' dialog ignores touch, press Enter on a keyboard. Long sessions, later levels and clean shutdown are untested. Keep the game in the container's internal storage (FEX needs executable mappings).
